scripts.dev: pnpm --filter @synvora/shared run build && pnpm run build && node --env-file=.env --watch dist/server.js
scripts.test:db: pnpm --filter @synvora/shared run build && SYNVORA_DB_TESTS=1 node --env-file=.env ./node_modules/vitest/vitest.mjs run
scripts.test:restart: pnpm --filter @synvora/shared run build && pnpm run build && SYNVORA_RESTART_TEST=1 node --env-file=.env ./node_modules/vitest/vitest.mjs run
